thread:
amanda: Quick ping — pushed a microbatch scheduler tweak to canary earlier. Microbench on longseq (8k) shows a ~12% p95 regression vs baseline. Can someone eyeball? PR: https://git.redwood/infra/microbatch#branch/feature/horizon-tune  Bench artifacts: https://perf.redwood/artifacts/4312345678 :eyes:

bench-bot: perf-check CI: perf job completed — artifacts uploaded. diff summary link above.

raj: Can you paste the exact bench command + raw p50/p95/p99 numbers? Also was this run on stable canary or a fresh image?

amanda: bench command I used:
```
bench run --model opt-1.3b --seq 8192 --batch 4 --runs 5 --config microbatch-longseq
```
Summary (baseline -> candidate): p50 80ms -> 88ms (+10%), p95 230ms -> 258ms (+12%), p99 480ms -> 515ms (+7%). Mem resident ~11.8GB -> 11.9GB (+1%).

theo: :eyes: Which commit? Iirc the change touched dynamic horizon + prefill gating.

amanda: commit abc1234 — yes, horizon heuristic and a prefill small gating change. I expected throughput improvements on mixed workloads but this specifically bumps the longseq tail.

raj: What's variance across the 5 runs? Could be noise.

amanda: 5 runs p95 list: [250, 260, 255, 252, 258] (ms). sd ~2.5% on p95. Not just a single outlier.

emily: Can you drop the full perf artifact link here? want the heatmap + raw traces.

amanda: https://perf.redwood/artifacts/4312345678/longseq-heatmap.html  (contains traces + env diff)

theo: OK. Looks like a tail bump concentrated in certain shards. Two options: revert the scheduler tweak, or tighten the horizon cap for long sequences and rerun. Revert is fastest safety option.

amanda: If we revert, can we get quick approval? @theo can you open a revert PR? I'm leaning revert to avoid customer impact.

theo: I can open a small patch instead that sets dynamic_horizon_cap=0.6 when seq>4096 and leave the rest. Will put up PR in ~30m. prefer to try that first and rerun benches.

raj: I prefer a rerun with the cap before full revert. If the cap brings p95 back within SLO, we can iterate. Please run 3 fresh canary runs to be safe.

emily: +1 — I'll queue the canary jobs as soon as theo's patch is up. I can also compare the KV cache hit patterns across runs.

bench-bot: Canary perf job queued: job #4312345721 (watch: https://perf.redwood/jobs/4312345721).

amanda: Thanks all — holding any merge. Current SLA p95 target is <240ms so this is material. Will wait for bench results; @theo ping me when patch PR is ready. :thumbsup:
